page_title: WHU 1-2 NOT | West Ham v Nottingham Forest 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: da Silva Moreira E. Ankle Injury

commentary.text: 90+17' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+16' The referee gives a yellow card to Carlos Soler (West Ham).
90+15' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+15' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Morato (Nottingham) is given a yellow card.
90+15' Murillo (Nottingham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

90+13' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
90+13' Now West Ham have a corner.
90+12' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+11' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+10' Jota Silva (Nottingham) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
90+10' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
90+8' Some patient build-up play from Nottingham as they look to unlock the defence.
90+6' Nottingham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+5' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ryan Yates (Nottingham) replacing Nicolas Dominguez.
90+5' Jota Silva (Nottingham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Anthony Elanga.
90+4' Fouls committed – 14:7.
90' 11 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) for his blatant foul.

86' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the top left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:2.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Elliot Anderson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham).
83' Here is a change. Morgan Gibbs-White is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Danilo (Nottingham).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahim Sangare leaves the pitch and Morato (Nottingham) comes on.
81' Luis Guilherme (West Ham) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
81' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from West Ham.
79' Graham Potter prepares a substitution. Mohammed Kudus is replaced by Luis Guilherme (West Ham).
79' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
79' West Ham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
73' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

71' Carlos Soler (West Ham) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Matz Sels pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
69' The corner kick from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
69' Nottingham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
66' Referee Samuel Barrott signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Nottingham players have a reason to celebrate!
62' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Nottingham players aren’t happy.

61' 0 - 2 Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) determinedly makes his way to the ball from the resulting set piece, but only manages to connect with his body. It's enough to beat the goalkeeper, however, and make it 0:2.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Soler (West Ham) comes onto the pitch for James Ward-Prowse.
58' Graham Potter has decided to substitute Tomas Soucek and he is replaced by Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham).
58' Substitution. Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) on for Guido Rodriguez.
58' The substitution is prepared. Edson Alvarez (West Ham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aaron Cresswell.
57' Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

56' Good chance for Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
56' Neco Williams (Nottingham) is able to continue to play.
54' Neco Williams (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
53' West Ham have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) was quite harsh and Samuel Barrott didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Ball possession – 57:43.
48' Great teamplay by West Ham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

48' What a poor attempt! Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
46' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
46' Murillo (Nottingham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+7' The resulting corner, taken by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham), comes to nothing.
45+6' It doesn’t look good for Murillo (Nottingham); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
45+5' Murillo (Nottingham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
45+4' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
45+3' Neco Williams (Nottingham) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
45+2' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
45+1' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45' 5:4 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
42' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
42' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the right post. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
40' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends a long ball forward to Neco Williams, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
39' Neat passing move from West Ham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
37' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner but it's cleared.
36' Murillo (Nottingham) brings an opponent down and Samuel Barrott interrupts the game.
34' Some great controlled play and passing from West Ham. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
34' The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.

32' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) meets a cross from Aaron Cresswell, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
31' Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) jumps into a tackle and Samuel Barrott signals a foul.
29' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
29' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
28' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
27' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
26' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
26' The West Ham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' Looks like Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
25' Chris Wood (Nottingham) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
24' The linesman makes the right call and Nottingham will have a corner.
23' Chris Wood (Nottingham) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
22' Nottingham are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
19' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
18' The West Ham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
16' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
14' The ball possession at the moment is 61:39.
11' 0 - 1 GOAL! And it’s the keeper’s mistake after his poor pass is easily intercepted close in by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), who gleefully fires it into the net. That makes it 0:1.

9' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards goal from a promising distance, but Alphonse Areola denies him.
9' Samuel Barrott blows for a foul after Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
7' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

7' Well-positioned Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Matz Sels reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!

6' That didn't go as planned! Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Alphonse Areola, who easily kept it out.

5' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
4' A raking crossfield pass from Ola Aina (Nottingham) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
2' West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the right post, but Matz Sels is prepared and dives to thwart him.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
West Ham will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Samuel Barrott.
